Long Description:

Certified Manufacturing Technician is an immersive VR training application created exclusively for students enrolled in the ImmerseLearn Manufacturing Technician certification program.

This application allows learners to gain hands-on experience in a virtual manufacturing environment, helping them build confidence and practical skills through realistic simulations.
